Cederburg et al. (2020) is cited as the main counter-evidence: volatility management does not improve Sharpe out of sample for many factors, although the market factor is among the better cases; the literature prior (+20 trials) is accepted. Known risk: in the dev period stock-bond correlation is mostly negative, so IEF tends to rally in the stressed state; the second mechanism criterion is there to separate that from the volatility-timing effect.
